readme: Photography used in the artefact. Sourced from Unsplash under the Unsplash License, which permits commercial and non commercial use without permission. Attribution is not required by the licence but is recorded here because Stage 1 requires every asset to be traceable to a source and a date. Usernames are as shown on Unsplash; confirm display names before any public launch.
